summary: HDFC Bank filed a Form 6-K announcing it will exercise its call option to redeem INR 7.39 billion (approximately $89 million) of Additional Tier 1 bonds issued September 30, 2021, in full on the first call date, September 30, 2026, at 100% of principal plus accrued interest. A letter was sent to trustee Citibank, N.A., London Branch on September 1, 2026, instructing notice to bondholders. This is a routine debt redemption under the bond's terms, not a special situation. No equity securities, premiums, or strategic implications are involved. This mirrors an ordinary issuer redemption notice.
